summary: The most critical issues are SQL Injection [s1.f1] and Hardcoded Secret [s1.f2]. Division by Zero [s1.f3] and Bare Except [s1.f4] are less severe but still important.

findings.title: SQL Injection
findings.detail: SQL injection vulnerability due to direct string concatenation in SQL query.

evidence.quote: query = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ' + name + '';

findings.title: Hardcoded Secret
findings.detail: Hardcoded API key in the code, exposing sensitive information.

findings.title: Division by Zero
findings.detail: Division operation that can raise a ZeroDivisionError if input is empty.

findings.title: Bare Except
findings.detail: Bare except clause can catch and hide errors like KeyboardInterrupt.
